messages.content:
The issue reported states that the `HelpFormatter` class goes into an infinite loop when there is not enough space to display a word on a single line, leading to a JVM crash with an `OutOfMemoryError`. The failing test case `testLongLineChunkingIndentIgnored` in `BugCLI162Test` sets up options with a long description and uses `HelpFormatter` to print help with a specific width.

Looking at the test case, it seems to be setting up an option `"x"` with a long description and then printing the help using `HelpFormatter` with a width of 22 columns.

The `HelpFormatter` class has a `printHelp` method that is called in the failing test. This method internally calls another overloaded version of `printHelp` with additional parameters.

To diagnose this issue, we need to inspect the implementation of the `printHelp` method in the `HelpFormatter` class to identify why it might be going into an infinite loop when handling long descriptions and specific widths.

Next, we will take a closer look at the `org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp` method to understand the internal logic.
The behavior you are observing in the failing test case is likely due to a problem in the `org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp` method. The method seems to be encountering an issue when handling long descriptions within a specific width, leading to an infinite loop and eventual JVM crash with an `OutOfMemoryError`.

To address this issue, you should focus on fixing the logic within the `HelpFormatter.printHelp` method to handle long descriptions and specified widths correctly.

Considering the symptom described in the bug report, the following method should be improved:

```
org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp(java.io.PrintWriter, int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.apache.commons.cli.Options, int, int, java.lang.String)
```

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).

```
org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp(java.io.PrintWriter, int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.apache.commons.cli.Options, int, int, java.lang.String)
```
